speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (specifically involving the belief of lost telepathic abilities). The patient's core complaint is a fixed, non-bizarre delusion regarding a specific loss of a special ability, accompanied by somatic preoccupation, with no other psychotic features like hallucinations or disorganized speech currently reported. The eight-month duration and lack of substance use support this diagnosis over a primary psychotic disorder or substance-induced psychosis.
